learning_objective: 🎯 Learn the secrets to drawing human faces and figures by understanding simple proportions and capturing real emotions!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Human heads are not perfect circles; they are actually shaped like upside-down eggs! Starting your face drawing with a simple oval helps you place the eyes, nose, and mouth in the right spots.
Proportion is all about size and spacing. Did you know your eyes are usually right in the middle of your head? Learning these simple measuring tricks makes drawing people super easy.
Eyebrows and mouths are the superstars of emotion! Just by tilting the eyebrows down or curving a smile, you can make your portrait look angry, surprised, happy, or sad.
To draw a moving person, start with a quick stick figure to capture their action or gesture. Then, build up their body with soft shapes over the lines.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Funny Mirror Face
fun_activity.instructions: Stand in front of a mirror and make the silliest, most surprised face you can. Notice what happens to your eyebrows and mouth, then try to sketch your funny expression on paper!

quick_recap: ⭐ Start drawing faces with an oval shape, not a circle.
⭐ Use simple proportion rules to know exactly where to place the eyes, nose, and ears.
⭐ Change the eyebrows and mouth lines to show completely different emotions.
⭐ Practice drawing action by starting with stick figures and adding shapes to them.
